concepts.name: Projectile Motion
concepts.simple_definition: Projectile motion is the motion of an object thrown into the air, subject only to gravity.
concepts.deep_explanation: It consists of two independent perpendicular motions: constant horizontal velocity and constant vertical acceleration (-g).
concepts.real_example: A kicked football flying through the air follows a curved parabolic trajectory.
concepts.common_confusion: Thinking the acceleration at the highest point of projectile motion is zero. Gravity is always acting, so acceleration remains -9.8 m/s².
concepts.simple_definition_amharic: ፕሮጀክታይል እንቅስቃሴ ማለት ወደ አየር ከተወረወረ በኋላ በስበት ኃይል ብቻ የሚመራ እንቅስቃሴ ነው።
concepts.deep_explanation_amharic: ሁለት ገለልተኛ እንቅስቃሴዎችን ይይዛል፡ አግድም ቋሚ ፍጥነት (horizontal velocity) እና ቀጥተኛ ቋሚ መጣደፍ (vertical acceleration)።
concepts.real_example_amharic: ወደ አየር የተመታ እግር ኳስ የተጠማዘዘ ፓራቦሊክ መንገድን ይከተላል።
concepts.common_confusion_amharic: በከፍተኛው ቦታ ላይ ማጣደፉ 0 ነው ብሎ ማሰብ። የስበት ማጣደፍ ሁልጊዜ -9.8 ሜ/ሰ² ሆኖ ይቀጥላል።
